Maria (CSM): FYI Cerulean AI asked for a temporary allowlist + rate bump for an APAC demo next Tue. They want primary traffic to apac-east and eu-west as fallback. Renewal touchpoint next month so this is high priority :exclamation:
Ajay (NetOps): can you share source IPs/CIDRs and desired qps? also, header pinning or mTLS?
Maria (CSM): CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25. Requested 500 qps (aggregate) during the demo window 09:00-12:00 APAC local. Duration = 72h window (prep + demo + cooldown). They prefer header pinning (X-Client-ID) not mTLS.
Ingrid (Platform Eng): ok. do we want a per-account temporary policy or a global allowlist? recommend per-customer policy 'cerulean-demo-apac-eu' so we can autorevoke. sample config below.
```
route: cerulean-demo
primary_region: apac-east
fallback_region: eu-west
allowlist:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
  - 198.51.100.128/25
rate_limit:
  default: 50r/s
  demo_override: 500r/s # 09:00-12:00 APAC
window: 72h
autorevoke: true
```
Ajay (NetOps): thanks. i'll need a support/finance exception on record for the service-level change — is the PO/credit confirmed?
Maria (CSM): finance signed off (CRM deal CER-412). i'll drop the approval PDF into the ticket after this thread.
Ryan (SRE): firewall will need a netops ticket with explicit CIDRs + time window. @Ajay can you open NETOPS ticket? Also suggest adding a fallback to a smaller quantized model family to reduce tail latency if apac capacity spikes.
Ajay (NetOps): opening ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NETOPS-8476 — will include CIDRs, time window, and approver tag.
deploy-bot: Policy 'cerulean-demo-apac-eu' created in staging by Ingrid at 6112233505 — canary rollout queued :rocket:
Ingrid (Platform Eng): rolling out canary 20% -> 50% -> 100% with latency SLO checks. i'll prime KV cache and warm routes ahead of demo. rollback if p95 > 200ms for >2min.
Maria (CSM): can we confirm ETA for prod completion? need to tell the customer we'll be ready 24h before demo.
Ingrid (Platform Eng): ETA prod rollout complete by 6112233560 (tomorrow 14:00 UTC).
Maria (CSM): perfect — i'll notify Cerulean and add a renewal note on the account: flagged as 'renewal-risk: high' due to expected surge impact on cost. :thumbsup:
